header: The package must carry the security-relevant UI rules verbatim so they cannot be dropped in implementation

caveat.twap.string: CandleViewer runs this TWAP, not Bybit. It keeps running if you close this window. If CandleViewer's server stops or loses its connection to Bybit, no new slices are sent; a slice already at Bybit can still fill. Your stop-loss at Bybit keeps working.

caveat.iceberg.string: CandleViewer runs this iceberg, not Bybit: Bybit only sees one small order at a time. It keeps running if you close this window. If CandleViewer's server stops or loses its connection to Bybit, nothing refills; the order already at Bybit can still fill. Your stop-loss at Bybit keeps working.

caveat.chase.string: CandleViewer moves this order, not Bybit. It keeps chasing if you close this window. If CandleViewer's server stops or loses its connection to Bybit, the order stays at its last price at Bybit and can still fill there. Your stop-loss at Bybit keeps working.

caveat.gap.string: (at most one more slice may already be on its way)

tag.emulated.2.string: Emulated — run by CandleViewer, not Bybit

help.emulated.string: Bybit's API has no TWAP, iceberg, chase or OCO order type, so CandleViewer's server places and manages the individual orders for you.

stop.algo_builder.1.string: Every slice this {TWAP} sends carries a native stop-loss at Bybit — {63,900.0}, your position's stop or tighter. Bybit holds it whether or not CandleViewer is running.

stop.algo_builder.2.string: Every order this chase places (and each price change of it) carries a native stop-loss at Bybit — {63,900.0}, your position's stop or tighter. Bybit holds it whether or not CandleViewer is running.

stop.algo_builder.reduce_only.string: This {TWAP} is reduce-only: it cannot open a position, so it sends no new stop; your position's stop at Bybit, {63,900.0}, stays.

stop.disconnect.string: Stop-losses at Bybit are held by Bybit and work whether or not CandleViewer is running.

caveat.oco_entry.string: CandleViewer links these two orders, not Bybit: as one fills, it shrinks or cancels the other. It keeps working if you close this window. If CandleViewer's server is down or has lost Bybit when one fills, the other stays live and can fill too, so you could hold both. Your position keeps its stop-loss at Bybit.

caveat.oco_exit.string: CandleViewer links these two exits, not Bybit: as one fills, it shrinks or cancels the other. It keeps working if you close this window. If CandleViewer's server is down at that moment, the other exit stays at Bybit until it is back; it is reduce-only, so it cannot add to your position.

stop.interim.string: CandleViewer places a stop-loss at Bybit as soon as the first part fills (its deadline is 2 s). If it cannot — the server is down, Bybit is unreachable, or Bybit refuses the stop — the filled part has no stop-loss until it can, and you are alerted.

stop.at_bybit.8.string: No stop at Bybit — alert raised

oco.mode.string: As one fills, it shrinks or cancels the other (reduce_other).

oco.extra_exit.string: Your position's native stop stays at Bybit; this stop-market leg is an extra exit CandleViewer manages.

oco.native_hint.string: A plain take-profit + stop-loss belongs on Bybit's own TP/SL — Edit SL/TP.

oco.race.string: When one leg fills, CandleViewer shrinks the other by the filled size and cancels it when the first is fully filled. If both fill before either cancel lands, CandleViewer closes the extra size with a reduce-only market order and tells you.
